{{Quote|The mercenary group was called Blood Company. Run by an alien warlord who was part of the "Manaan Atrocities," according to your files.|Chanya Medaal|<ref name="TOR:TDP" />}}
'''Blood Company''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit that was hired by [[Bouris Ulgo]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] to exterminate the [[Soros]] hive of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. The group was led by an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who participated in the [[Manaan Atrocities]]. Blood Company was absorbed by the Soros hive and became [[Joiner]]s, and their aggression and knowledge spread to the Killiks.
